$comment: Project settings — loaded automatically by any Claude Code session opened in
this repository. CI passes .claude/qa-ci-settings.json explicitly instead.
Both files register the SAME guard, and that is deliberate. Without this
file, a local session would get the agents and skills but none of the
enforcement: patch-smith could edit tests, spec-oracle could read the
implementation, and any agent could launder a snapshot. That is the
degraded mode the whole design exists to prevent (§P5) — agents with advice
The guard is a no-op for ordinary work: with no agent_type in the payload,
the main session is treated as the orchestrator and only the global rules
apply (no snapshot laundering, no editing the gates from inside a session).
